title: Phonological Awareness Compound Words Playdough Mats Freebie

overview.description: Compound word playdough mats. The child forms each component word from playdough on a mat, then combines them. Likely format: mat with two boxes (word 1 + word 2) and an equals/arrow pointing to a third box (compound word). Child rolls playdough into letters or shapes representing each word. Combines phonological awareness (compound words) + fine motor (playdough manipulation) + tactile learning. FOURTH compound word format from Aless.

notes: Link likely expired. Fourth compound word format: (1) chain game = auditory/social, (2) snowball fight = kinesthetic/movement, (3) puzzles = tactile/self-correcting, (4) playdough mats = kinesthetic/creative/fine-motor. Aless has now shown FOUR different game mechanics for ONE phonological awareness skill. This is the strongest demonstration yet of the multi-modal principle: same skill × multiple activity formats = every child finds their way in.
